_: S2-G living posters. Four CHANNELS; a channel is one 192x384 slot in one shared atlas texture, so the whole layer is one draw call and one upload. Each channel cycles its items. `kind` video items are ~5.3 s seamless ping-pong loops (tools/gen_posters.py), stills are hard-compressed jpgs. `word` is drawn by the compositor at runtime, not baked — Flux cannot spell and a strapline is what makes a picture read as an advert. `hold` is seconds on screen. Aspect is 0.5, the same band data/signs.json bakes its eight poster tiles at, so DECISIONS decision 9's size ruler is unchanged.
